sf022_phase1_new_candidates.name: DIFrauD SMS Domain Split (redasers/difraud sms/)
sf022_phase1_new_candidates.rejection_reason: 4,752 of 6,574 rows (72.28%) match normalized_sha256 entries in legacy 2002-2011 UCI #228 SMS Spam Collection; collapses commercial promotional spam into binary positive label 1.

sf022_phase1_new_candidates.name: A Balanced Dataset for Spam and Smishing Detection using Large Language Models (LLMs)
sf022_phase1_new_candidates.rejection_reason: Primary Mendeley metadata explicitly states 'A large language model (LLM) was trained to create this dataset' to balance 3,397 rows/class; fails real-world Class C authenticity requirement and exposes null/unverified API license field.

sf022_phase1_new_candidates.name: ealvaradob/phishing-dataset (SMS subset)
sf022_phase1_new_candidates.rejection_reason: SMS text portion mirrors Mendeley f45bkkt8pr.1 (Mishra & Soni), already rejected in SF-010 for 56.6% exact normalized UCI #228 overlap and redaction confounding.

sf022_phase1_new_candidates.name: grephon777/phishing-dataset
sf022_phase1_new_candidates.rejection_reason: Derived mirror of Mendeley f45bkkt8pr.1 / ealvaradob phishing-dataset rather than an independent primary carrier collection.

sf022_phase1_new_candidates.name: UniqueData/spam-text-messages-dataset
sf022_phase1_new_candidates.rejection_reason: Only 25 preview examples exposed; CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0 restricts commercial/derivative processing and lacks documented incident sampling frame.

sf022_phase1_new_candidates.name: PhishVN Threat Intelligence & LLM-Paraphrased Dataset
sf022_phase1_new_candidates.rejection_reason: Vietnamese URL/phishing intelligence and LLM-paraphrased evasion benchmark; incompatible language/modality with English SMS carrier corpus.

sf022_phase1_new_candidates.name: SMS Fraud Classification dataset for Chichewa
sf022_phase1_new_candidates.rejection_reason: 676 Chichewa-origin messages with human/machine translations; translation artifacts and regional dialect do not evaluate real-world English A2P/P2P smishing distribution.

conclusion: Zero qualifying Class C datasets identified across 20 prior routes (SF-010/SF-011) and 7 newly audited SF-022 Phase 1 candidates. External evaluation remains UNAVAILABLE / BLOCKED; frozen SF-019 model and synthetic Dev/Val artifacts remain unmodified.
